title: Vendors and stalls
description: Themed stalls and vendors at Battle for Middle-earth 2026 — costumes, fabrics, leather accessories, jewellery, weapons and other Middle-earth gear.
subtitle: Market, crafts and things that belong in Middle-earth.
intro: On site you’ll find themed gear — costumes, fabrics, leather accessories, jewellery, weapons and other things that may come in handy in Middle-earth.
warning: The organisers do not guarantee that everything from everyone will be available on site. If you need something specific from a specific vendor, arrange it with them in advance.
empty_body: We accept vendor applications continuously. Once we confirm the first stalls, they will appear here with assortment descriptions and links.
empty_btn: I want to apply as a vendor
cta_heading: Are you a vendor and want to join?
cta_body: Find all the details on the vendors page — what we’re looking for, how to apply, what we provide and what the vendor provides.

vendors.name: U Zeleného draka
paragraphs: The pub is run by the U Zeleného draka crew: Ondřej Teplý (Flejm), Tobiáš Tyc (Mýval), Matouš Frič (Střevo).
The pub space will be extended to 3 large tents, forming an enclosed area. There'll also be a central camp area and supporting facilities.
Bring your own mug and bowl — plastic dishes will be charged for, so the meadow doesn't end up littered with cups.

vendors.name: Linea obchod
paragraphs: We sell natural fabrics (linen, cotton, wool, silk, dupioni) and make various products from them.
We focus on home textiles (bed linen, tablecloths, etc.), bags, home accessories and fashion accessories. You'll also find other natural materials (leather) here.
As an addition we also offer a selection of goods for historical fencing.

vendors.name: ZZ Armoury
paragraphs: I'm a small company making swords, sabres, arrows and other weapons for LARP and historical battles.
We can also make shields of all shapes, sword scabbards and costume accessories such as belts, pouches, bracers and arrow quivers.
This year we're also bringing some forged accessories for the camp.

vendors.name: Baldonovo brašnářství
paragraphs: Baldonovo brašnářství is a small workshop in northern Bohemia, gradually evolving from the classic "let's-do-it-ourselves" version. A few years ago we started making belts and bags for friends, but over time the demand and the wish to try other things grew into a need to present ourselves publicly, and an e-shop was born.

We currently make leather accessories for everyday use, historical fencing, cosplay and fantasy events. In cooperation with the local forge nielo-sword.com we also make scabbards and sheaths for replicas of historical weapons, we can make a hunting-rifle case in classic English style, and we're playing with wool, linen and wood.
On site we'll showcase current standard production, a one-off or two, and if it works out, leather work itself.

vendors.name: Sněděná Karkulka
paragraphs: Straps and belts with a soul. Going to a LARP or historical fencing event? Want to wear something original? Have a dog, cat or maybe a horse? Play guitar?
Then Sněděná Karkulka is for you. We offer hand-woven tablet-woven items and custom production.

vendors.name: Luboš Vostek
paragraphs: Sale of furs, leather bracers and other leather accessories.
Plus bronze and brass kettles, pewter ware, wool blankets, wooden chests and other things for camp and costume.

vendors.name: Saracénovo veteštnictví
vendors.category: Jewellery from wood, bone and antler
paragraphs: Saracénovo veteštnictví offers various jewellery made of wood, bone and antler.
You'll find almost anything — from earrings to carved bowls, from pendants to burned skulls. In short, everything a human or an orc could wish for.

vendors.name: František Šín
paragraphs: Sale of minerals and jewellery made from them.
I regularly travel to historical fairs.

vendors.name: Lesklý věcičky
vendors.category: Tinned jewellery and accessories with minerals
paragraphs: Sale of handmade tinned jewellery and accessories with minerals.
You'll find rings, pendants, earrings and dreadlock beads inspired by nature, Nordic mythology or even The Lord of the Rings.
I regularly travel to historical fairs.

vendors.name: Zajda Art keramika
paragraphs: A small workshop making one-of-a-kind ceramic pieces — whether you are after a goblet for larp, a mug for your morning coffee, or something made just for you.
Most pieces are made in small batches, and if you get in touch, I will gladly make a personalised piece to order.
Look forward to mugs, goblets and bowls, as well as jewellery made from ceramics and minerals.

vendors.name: Mathea art & pyro
paragraphs: Hi, I am Mathea, also known as the Bone Crone — an oddball who likes getting lost in the woods. I make jewellery inspired by nature in all its forms, from a sunlit meadow to dark, impenetrable forests.
Making things is my way of coming to terms with the world, with its brighter and its darker sides alike.
You will find jewellery made from ethically sourced bone, antler, metal, horn and wood. Put an interesting material in my hands and I will find a way to turn it into a piece of jewellery.
